# 12.EP — Example Problems (Topic 12)

A support module for **Topic 12 (Combustion & Reacting Mixtures)**: the worked
**Examples** from Moran 8e Ch.13–14, transcribed and **regenerated by code** so every
published answer is verified. Part of the `12.EQ / 12.EP / 12.HP` support set
(`modules/Thermo/plan.txt`).

## Contents
- `examples.md` — the 9 Examples (13.1–13.2, 13.4–13.8, 14.1–14.2): GIVEN / FIND /
  ANSWER / METHOD + page.
- `code/examples.py` — each example regenerated from its GIVEN data, embedding the
  **same** Table A-23/A-25/A-27 values Moran quotes (stepwise rounding preserved).
- `code/test_examples.py` — asserts each result matches the book's answer.

## Coverage
| Example | topic | book answer |
|---------|-------|-------------|
| 13.1 | octane air–fuel ratio, theoretical & 150% air | AF̄=59.5→AF=15.1; 89.25→22.6, φ=0.67 |
| 13.2 | methane dry-product analysis, dew point | AF=19.47, 113% theo, dew pt 134 °F, 0.489 lbmol vapor |
| 13.4 | IC engine, liquid octane (English units) | Q̇cv = −22.22 Btu/s |
| 13.5 | gas turbine, methane + 400% air | Ẇcv = 5.74 MW |
| 13.6 | closed rigid vessel, CH₄ + 2O₂ → 900 K | Q = −745,436 kJ, p₂ = 3.02 atm |
| 13.7 | methane enthalpy of combustion / heating values | HHV 890,330 (55,507); LHV 802,310 (50,019); @1000 K 800,552 kJ/kmol |
| 13.8 | adiabatic flame temperature, liquid octane | (a) 2395 K theo air; (b) 962 K @400% |
| 14.1 | equilibrium constant, CO + ½O₂ ⇌ CO₂ | log₁₀K = 45.093 (298 K), 2.885 (2000 K) |
| 14.2 | CO₂ dissociation composition vs pressure | z=0.129 (1 atm), 0.062 (10 atm); yCO₂=0.818→0.91 |

## Run
```bash
cd code
python3 examples.py          # regenerate each answer beside the book value
python3 test_examples.py     # -> "All 49 tests passed."
```

## Files
`examples.md`, `code/examples.py`, `code/test_examples.py`, `refs.md`.
